headline: Leeds condemn 'disgusting' alleged racist abuse of Jayden Bogle after Spurs game
description: Leeds have condemned alleged racist abuse of defender Jayden Bogle on social media following Saturday's 1-0 Premier League win over Tottenham at Elland Road.

headline: Man United's poor starts have Premier League relegation looking more likely
description: Man United have a penchant for waking up *after* games have already started -- and it's why they face Premier League relegation.

headline: Man United rescue 4-4 draw vs. Aston Villa but remain in relegation zone
description: Manchester United fought back for a chaotic 4-4 draw against Aston Villa on Sunday after twice going two goals down at Old Trafford.

headline: Man United twice come from two goals down to salvage point against Aston Villa
description: Two goals down inside four minutes against Aston Villa in the Premier League on Sunday and trailing 4-2 going into second-half added time, Manchester United rallied to a 4-4 draw on another night of mayhem and drama at Old Trafford.

headline: Premier League live updates: Man United, in relegation zone, host Villa
description: Manchester United needed to beat Aston Villa at Old Trafford to avoid spending the international break in the Premier League's bottom three.
